comment: Alesis ModFX Bitrman-inspired lo-fi chain whose blocks can be REORDERED. Four blocks -- bitcrush+decimate, drive, ring mod, comb -- one knob each, plus a Route knob that permutes them. The reordering is the point: crush before a comb is a different pedal from a comb before crush, and slot order in a patch reorders whole effects, never stages inside one.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category, matching the rest of the release pack.
fxid_comment: 0x1D1. Free as of the 2026-08-18 fxid audit; every id in the tree is unique.

params.name: Route
params.comment: Block order: BDRC, CRDB, DBCR, RCBD, BRDC. On knob 1 deliberately -- it is the control this effect exists for, and knobs 1-2 use the verbatim-stock edit handlers.

params.name: Bits
params.comment: Word length and sample-rate decimation together, 12-bit down to 3-bit with the hold rising alongside.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: Asymmetric soft clip, gain-compensated so turning it up does not just get louder.

params.name: Ring
params.comment: Ring modulator carrier, 30 Hz to ~2.2 kHz. Depth fades in from silence at 0 so the block is genuinely absent when down.

params.name: Comb
params.comment: Short feedback comb, depth and length together. The only feedback path here, clamped below unity so no routing can make it run away.
